prompt: Stage 2-2, level 4, 8 gold, 100 HP. You have just been paired against Seat 5. Four things happen in every player round. Put them in the order they happen.

steps: Your board fights Seat 5's board on its own; you can only watch
Gold arrives and the shop shows five new champions for free
The loser of the fight takes HP damage and the next round begins
During the planning timer you buy, sell, level and move champions

explanation:
Every round has the same shape: income and a free shop first, then a planning timer where every decision happens, then a fight you only watch, then the damage. The order matters because nothing can be changed once the timer ends: the copy you did not buy and the unit you did not move stay that way for the whole fight.

The tempting swap is putting the fight before the shopping, as if you could react to how it goes. You cannot. You prepare, you watch, and you adjust in the next planning phase.
principle: Prepare during the timer, watch the fight, adjust next round.
commonMistake: Waiting to see how the fight goes before spending, then running out of timer with gold unspent and copies unbought.
hint: Think about when the shop refreshes for free and when you are actually allowed to click on anything.
